settings.title: Omadjinn - Floating Window Controls
settings.subtitle: Snap layouts for floating windows
feature.dragRestore.label: Restore size on drag-out
feature.dragRestore.description: Dragging a snapped window out with SUPER + LEFT MOUSE resizes it to Omarchy's default floating size.
feature.snapTiled.label: Snap tiled windows too
feature.snapTiled.description: Off: snap only moves windows that are already floating. On: snapping a tiled or scrolling window floats it first.
feature.rightClickMenu.label: Right-click menu on titlebars
feature.rightClickMenu.description: Right-click a floating window's titlebar to pick a zone or change the layout. Needs Omarchy's floating workspace, which draws the titlebars.
menu.title: OMADJINN
toc.title: Contents
keys.soon: Click Edit, then press the new keys. Esc cancels.
keys.needmod: Include SUPER, CTRL, SHIFT or ALT with the key.
layouts.restored: Built-in layouts restored. Your file was kept as ~/.config/omadjinn/
layouts.restored.none: You are already using the built-in layouts.
editor.hint: Click a zone, then split it. Drag a line to move it. Click a line, then Merge line to join the zones on its two sides.
editor.cannot: This layout has overlapping zones or gaps, so it can't be drawn here. Edit it in layouts.json.
feature.swap.label: Swap windows while snapping
feature.swap.description: Off: a snapped window lands on top of the one already in the zone. On: the two trade places, and the other window takes the spot yours came from.
about.bio1: Omadjinn (emphasis on the long d) was built by Tony Farson. A dude playing out his midlife crisis by proving he can learn new tricks. By trade, I am a 25 year career in information technology infrastructure and support, customer success, and now SaaS product and release management. My new passion is building AI solutions with an emphasis on trust, observability, and governance/compliance.
about.bio2: I use local and frontier models in all aspects of my professional work and my tinkering projects. I design, drive, test, and QA. I dabble in code but let AI do the heavy lifting. Omadjinn is one such project. I hope you enjoy it.
